page_title: LIL 1-0 STR | Lille v Strasbourg 21/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The match has just finished.
90+7' Abakar Sylla (Strasbourg) has tested the patience of referee Benoit Millot and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

90+6' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the bottom right corner. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Alaa Bellaarouch makes a comfortable save.
90+4' Benoit Millot shows a yellow card to Tiago Santos (Lille) for his blatant foul.
90+4' Lucas Perrin (Strasbourg) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Lucas Chevalier, who smothers the ball.
90+2' The game is interrupted as Alexsandro (Lille) is flagged offside.
90+1' Today's match ends for Angel Gomes who will be replaced by Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille).
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg) is ready on the edge of the six-yard box and duly receives the cross, but his header fizzes just wide of the left post.
87' A substitution has been made. Jonathan David is replaced by Leny Yoro (Lille).
85' Patrick Vieira has decided to substitute Ibrahima Sissoko and he is replaced by Aboubacar Ali Abdallah (Strasbourg).
85' Some great controlled play and passing from Strasbourg. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
81' Moise Sahi Dion (Strasbourg) beats the defender to the ball in the box and shoots, but the ball flashes well past the left post.
80' Chance! Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) comes within inches of scoring after picking up a pass from Andrey Santos, but his shot from inside the box flashes inches wide of the right post.
78' One of the players from Lille times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
74' Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg) fails to deliver a cross from the free kick as his attempt is thwarted by the opposition's defence.
73' Remy Cabella (Lille) takes the corner with a short pass.
71' Patrick Vieira prepares a substitution. Dilane Bakwa is replaced by Jeremy Sebas (Strasbourg).
71' The referee signals a substitution. Moise Sahi Dion (Strasbourg) is brought on as a substitute for Frederic Guilbert.
69' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
68' Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg) smashes the ball from the edge of the box and misses well wide of the left post.

65' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
63' Paulo Fonseca has decided to make a change. Edon Zhegrova (Lille) replaces Yusuf Yazici.
63' Paulo Fonseca decides to make a substitution. Hakon Arnar Haraldsson will be replaced by Ivan Cavaleiro (Lille).
62' We are about to witness a substitution. Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) is replacing Ismaily.
61' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Emanuel Emegha, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
59' The game has begun to heat up. Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
58' Frederic Guilbert (Strasbourg) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
57' Ibrahima Sissoko (Strasbourg) was too forceful with his tackle and Benoit Millot interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
57' There's an opportunity for Frederic Guilbert (Strasbourg) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
54' Remy Cabella (Lille) decides to speed play up by quickly sending the free kick into the box.
52' The ball possession is 58:42.
50' Frederic Guilbert (Strasbourg) is able to continue to play.
47' Frederic Guilbert (Strasbourg) is being forced to leave the pitch in order to receive medical treatment and his team will play with a man short for a few minutes.
46' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) sends a chip pass into the box, but Lucas Chevalier is quickest to intercept the ball.
46' Half-time substitution. Saidou Sow (Strasbourg) is replaced by Marvin Senaya.
46' Patrick Vieira has made a change at the break. Emanuel Emegha has come on in place of Kevin Gameiro (Strasbourg).
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Alexsandro (Lille) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is so wild it sails way past the left post and behind for a goal kick.
45' It seemed like Yusuf Yazici (Lille) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
44' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Saidou Sow (Strasbourg) was quite harsh and Benoit Millot didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
43' Tiago Santos (Lille) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
42' Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.

41' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) meets a delivery on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards to the bottom left corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Lucas Chevalier pulls off an easy save.
39' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
37' Tiago Santos (Lille) gets inside the box and tries to beat Alaa Bellaarouch with a measured shot into the bottom right corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
35' Alexsandro (Lille) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
33' Dangerous play by Kevin Gameiro (Strasbourg). Benoit Millot blows his whistle for a foul.
31' The linesman raises his flag. Jonathan David (Lille) is adjudged offside.
30' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Remy Cabella (Lille), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
29' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) picks up a pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot before unleashing a low drive goalwards, but one of the defending players blocks his effort.
27' Yusuf Yazici (Lille) will take the corner.
25' Paulo Fonseca is stunned as referee Benoit Millot shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
25' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
23' Alexsandro (Lille) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
22' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) commits a rough foul. Benoit Millot stops the game and makes a call.
19' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Strasbourg.
18' Tiago Santos (Lille) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
15' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) sends a cross into the box, but Lucas Chevalier comes off his line to gather the ball.
12' 1 - 0 Jonathan David (Lille) receives a delightful pass inside the box and smashes a low shot into the bottom right corner. What a clinical finish!
10' Remy Cabella (Lille) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong.
10' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Yusuf Yazici (Lille), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
8' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
6' Tiago Santos (Lille) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
4' Tiago Santos (Lille) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
4' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Lille will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
4' Benjamin Andre (Lille) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
3' Jonathan David (Lille) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Lille will have the kick-off.
Benoit Millot was nominated as the referee for this game.
